summary: NetEase, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, announcing its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing is a routine earnings release for a foreign private issuer, reporting net revenues of RMB30.6 billion ($4.4 billion), a 6.1% year-over-year increase, with games and related value-added services contributing RMB25.7 billion. No special-situation corporate event such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing does not involve any transaction, board recommendation, or advisor. It is purely an operational and financial update with no structural changes, leaving no risk-arb angle to monitor.
